errors.evidence: The agent provides a detailed plan without actually using any tools to retrieve the data from the World Bank. It relies on "research literature and verified data" without demonstrating how it accessed that information.
errors.description: The agent hallucinates information and does not use the available tools to verify the answer, relying on pre-existing knowledge instead of data retrieval.

errors.evidence: The agent immediately jumps to creating a plan instead of first attempting to understand the task and identify the necessary tools to use.
errors.description: The agent incorrectly identifies the initial step as planning instead of data retrieval, potentially leading to a flawed approach.

errors.evidence: The agent should have immediately used the `search_agent` tool to find the relevant World Bank data but instead plans to do so without actually executing the search.
errors.description: The agent fails to utilize the appropriate tool (`search_agent`) at the beginning of the process, hindering its ability to find the correct answer.

scores.reliability_reasoning: The agent did not follow the instructions to find the data using the tools and relied on pre-existing knowledge.
scores.instruction_adherence_reasoning: The agent failed to adhere to the instructions of using tools to find the answer.
scores.plan_opt_reasoning: The plan itself is reasonable, but the agent did not execute it correctly by using the tools.
